title: AI doctrines
description: Utility AI weights, response curves and faction doctrines (spec SAI-006..SAI-011, SAI-014..SAI-016, TAI-007..TAI-016). The faction → doctrine link is factions.doctrine (SAI-010); a doctrine does not list its factions.

personality.description: SAI-010 (strategic doctrines): faction character as consideration inputs (not set)

contractUse.description: SAI-014: how readily it posts contracts

commitmentBonus.description: SAI-008: bonus term for objectives the faction already pursues, as {weight, curve {type, points}} (not set)

gainTerms.description: SAI-008: ownGain terms rated against the faction's ultimate goal: term name → {weight, curve {type, points}} (not set)
